{{Quote|But when was anything ever 'normal' in Cularin? We're an exceptional location, in an exceptional time. A Sith fortress, a Jedi academy, wars among smugglers, at least two different groups venerating the dark side of the Force, and your standard array of criminals and malcontents, to say nothing of the economic threats posed by those who would exploit our natural resources. There is no time for complacency.|[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]]|<ref name="Lanius">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20050609blanius|text=Conversations With Lanius}}</ref>}}
The '''Cularin system''', briefly known as the '''Reidi Artom VI system''', was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located on the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] border<ref name="Region">There are conflicting sources as to the system's region. The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' places it in the Mid Rim, while the [[Wizards of the Coast]] website places it in the Expansion Region. The website also states it is between Kalarba and Aridus, one of which is in each of the aforementioned regions. As such, it is likely the Cularin system is in the border.</ref> and was located just off the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]], between [[Kalarba/Legends|Kalarba]] and [[Aridus/Legends|Aridus]].<ref name="Living Force website">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20010906whatislf|text=What's the Living Force?}}</ref> It was a seven-planet [[Binary star/Legends|binary star]] system that contained the planets of [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] and [[Almas]].<ref name="Living Force Campaign Guide" /> It became a five-planet system when the planet [[Oblis]] was destroyed by the power of the [[Darkstaff]]. This destruction also knocked [[Dorumaa]] from its orbit to eventually become a moon of Almas.

==History==
The Cularin [[Star system/Legends|system]] was visited by [[Darth Rivan]] during the [[New Sith Wars]], leading to the creation of the [[Almas Sith fortress]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] eventually drove the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] out of the system and logged the system's name in a Republic database, and Cularin was forgotten.<ref name="Living Force Campaign Guide" />

Though the Cularin system was in a well-explored sector of [[Realspace/Legends|space]], and was close to a major [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperspace route]], it remained undiscovered due to the [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]] anomalies there. The dense cores of three of the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] created very large gravity reflections, which sometimes overlapped. Also, the cloud of [[Comet/Legends|comets]] in the seventh [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] created its own [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]] difficulties. It was best to revert from [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] outside of the comet cloud and make the calculations for entering the system after getting current readings on the behavior of the comets. Even this was not considered safe by most traders, who chose instead to come into the system by sublight, passing on the increased cost of operation to their customers through higher prices.<ref name="Eye of the Sun: A Cularin Presence">{{LivingForce|Eye of the Sun: A Cularin Presence}}</ref>

A scout named [[Reidi Artom]] rediscovered the Cularin system in [[232 BBY/Legends|232 BBY]], and conducted the first real exploration of the system. Others followed her, and settlements were built on most of the system's bodies. Due to the relative isolation of the system, crime rates were high: The local asteroid belt became a refuge for [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] and later for crime lords such as [[Riboga]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and his successor [[Nirama]].<ref name="Living Force Campaign Guide" />

[[File:Almas.jpg|thumb|left|100px|The planet Almas]]
The Cularin system joined the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] around [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], and immediately asked for military protection against the pirates; however, the [[Thaereian military]] forces proved inefficient in ending the pirate attacks,<ref name="Living Force Campaign Guide" /> and the Thaereian military proved to only [[Blockade of the Cularin system|blockade the system]].

Shortly thereafter, the entire system disappeared from [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] for almost a decade, reappearing during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The inhabitants of the system experienced no passage of time during this disappearance. Towards the end of the Clone Wars, [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Lavina Durada-Vashne Wren]] declared Cularin to be a sovereign system, aligned neither with the Republic nor the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. She was subsequently arrested by [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] on charges of [[Treason/Legends|treason]], and the system was occupied by Republic military forces.
The [[Cularin Licensing and Regulatory Bureau]] operated in this system during that time.
